title: Apply for a trade promotion gaming authority
summary: This page explains how to apply for a trade promotion gaming authority if you plan to run a free-entry competition with a total prize value exceeding $10,000.
intro:
You need a trade promotion gaming authority if you'd like run a free-entry competition with a total prize value of more than $10,000 to promote your business.

You can apply and pay online for a 1-year, 3-year or 5-year authority. The authority allows you to run trade promotion gaming activities during the valid period, provided you notify Fair Trading before each promotion.

### Notify Fair Trading

When you have a valid authority you must notify NSW Fair Trading at least 10 business days before the start date of each promotion that has a total prize value of more than $10,000.
who_can_apply: The competition must be free to enter (entry by purchasing goods or services at their normal retail value is allowed).
The total prize value must be more than $10,000.
The competition must be based on chance (such as a sweep, giveaway, or contest) and not skill.
The promotion must genuinely promote the goods or services of your business.
The promotion must take place on the nominated date.
The applicant must be conducting the trade promotion, including determining the winners, and involved in the management of any business benefiting from the promotion.
Participants must not be children, unless the rules of the trade promotion include an age limit.
what_you_need: An email address for the promotion licensee or contact person.
Written consent from an authorised person in the business if you are conducting the promotion on behalf of a business.

how_to_steps.text: Get the documents and information you need ready.
Follow the prompts to complete your application and pay the application fee.

more_info.text: For information about changes to rules, advertising, trade promotion administration and unclaimed prizes, visit NSW Fair Trading.

faqs.q: Do I need a trade promotion gaming authority?
faqs.a: You need this authority if you plan to run a free-entry competition with a total prize value of more than $10,000 to promote your business.

faqs.q: What must I do after getting the authority?
faqs.a: You must notify NSW Fair Trading at least 10 business days before the start date of each promotion that has a total prize value of more than $10,000.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for this authority?
faqs.a: To be eligible, the competition must be free to enter, have a total prize value over $10,000, be based on chance (not skill), genuinely promote your goods or services, and take place on a nominated date.
